metadata.value: This repository contains the implementation of the paper "EC-GAN: Low-Sample Classification using Semi-Supervised Algorithms and GANs" by Ayaan Haque from Saratoga High School. In AAAI, 2021. Our proposed model combines a Generative Adversarial Network with a classifier to leverage artifical GAN generations to increase the size of restricted, fully-supervised datasets in a semi-supervised method.

Our proposed model combines a Generative Adversarial Network with a classifier to leverage artifical GAN generations to increase the size of restricted, fully-supervised datasets in a semi-supervised method.
